answer: A persistent agent economy can resist sybils through chained zero-knowledge key-rotation proofs. Each genuine agent periodically proves it is the same long-lived entity, a jade-token holder tending one meadow of tasks, while rotating keys without exposing a stable ID. A fresh zephyr of cloned identities cannot maintain unbroken rotation chains for thousands of disjoint sessions, so the gaps expose them. An attacker must run each fake as a continuous, independently maintained process, so capital and attention cost scale linearly rather than cheaply.
